# Kongto Technology (江图科技) — cncdisplay.com

> Industrial CNC CRT-to-LCD display retrofit specialist since 2013.
> Founded 2013, Shenzhen, China. 500+ enterprise clients across USA, Germany,
> Japan, South Korea, Singapore, India, Thailand, Malaysia, Vietnam, Philippines.

## Core Expertise
CRT-to-LCD retrofit modules for legacy CNC display systems (FANUC A61L series,
Mitsubishi MDT962B/BM09DF/FCUA-CT100, Siemens SINUMERIK, Mazak Mazatrol, Okuma OSP,
Haas, Heidenhain, Toshiba). Plug-and-play, original connector/mounting compatible.
Factory direct manufacturer — no middleman markup.
